title: Not accurate. Disappointed.
text:
Not accurate. Disappointed.. Highly inaccurate. Do not buy.

The temperature is very off. When the meat is 172 degress, it says the meat is 135. Ruined some expensive cuts of meat because of this cheap crap.

product_metadata.title: DOMAVER Digital Meat Thermometer, Updated Instant Read with Voice Broadcast Function Back-Light Magnetic Base for Home Kitchen Outdoor Food Cooking Grill Smoker BBQ, White/Black
features: 【No More Burned Meat】: DOMAVER voice playing instant read digital meat thermometer provides a quick, accurate reading within 2-3 seconds with a wide temp range -30℃ to 300℃/-22℉ to 572℉ and ±1℃（±2℉) accuracy. Yes, accurately measure the internal temp of daily foods, no more guessing work.

【Updated Preset Food Mode Design】: Never gets your meat to the perfect temp? This is a game changer. With 4 preset doneness options for Beef/Veal/Lamb including Well-Done/Medium/Med-Rare/Rare + 1 preset Well-Done mode for Hamburgers/Pork/Turkey/Chicken/Fish, you just click a few buttons, leave it alone, enjoying delicious food when it beeps. Easy as that!

【Easy to Use】: Automatically turns on when you pull open the probe and turns off when you close it. It supports both Celsius and F Readings, and comes with large back-light display and hold-to-read button for easy reading. Beep alarm function available.【Unique Voice Playing Assistance Design for children and elders.】

【Handy Magnet Storage】: The built-in magnetic is an absolute bonus, you can attach it on fridge, grill, oven, stove side, any metal surface for handy storage and access. Nice pocket size and build-in hanging hole for easy carrying and storage. Never worry about losing your food thermometer again.

【Perfect Family Gift】: It comes with practical preset food modes, user instruction, a handy clip and fine package (Batteries Not Included) . Super practical for making well-cooked steak, chicken, turkey, pork, fish, lamb, toast, candy, milk and coffee. Great for BBQ, grilling, smoking, baking, frying, etc. Enjoy your family time with no more burned meat. You won’t miss it!
